stem.text: Free electrons flow along a copper wire X of radius $5.0 \times 10^{-5}\,\text{m}$ with an average drift speed of $2.8 \times 10^{-2}\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The current in the wire is $3.0\,\text{A}$.
There is a current of $2.0\,\text{A}$ in a copper wire Y of radius $1.0 \times 10^{-4}\,\text{m}$.
What is the average drift speed of the free electrons in copper wire Y?
